items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: He introduced me to Charles Delaunay and another guy

ctx.x: But not only the other culture there, but you ran into a thing where the people who were into the music were really...

Well, Bean had told me about a lot about Paris, so I knew what to expect when I got there. Of course, he was on the show, too, you know. I didn't see him that much when I was in Paris, but I know when we'd play... Well, when we were supposed to be on stage together, we were there together. He hung out with other people. But Kenny Clarke and I hung out mostly in Paris. He introduced me to Charles Delaunay and another guy, an old fellow that was a Dixieland buff...
